prompt:
Create one readability-focused redesign mockup of the TripLOG expense screen. Preserve its Korean content, every expense and amount, branding, functions, and established palette. Match the original screen proportions. Use a compact budget summary and toolbar, with expenses aligned into clear description, category, date, and right-aligned amount columns. Keep repeated expenses separate. Use regular-weight descriptions, semibold headings and amounts, tabular numerals, subtle dividers, consistent spacing, and smaller category icons. Reduce oversized controls and heavy outlines. Keep a clear primary add-expense action, selected tab, and bottom navigation. Show the complete redesigned application screen.

Input images:
- Image 1: Original screen to improve for readability.
